title: Attribution Proposal Rejection
description: attribution-proposal-rejection/v1 — the approver refusing a proposed list. A proposal is never partly refused: the pledging side answers a rejection with a new proposal, not with an edit of this one. It carries details rather than one reason because a list is refused for per-line causes, and the pledging side has to know which lines to change.

detail.description: One objection, against one proposed line. Both codes are about a line, so the line is named.

assetId.description: The proposed line this objection is about.

code.description: Why this line is refused, as a closed vocabulary so a calculator can answer it without parsing prose. `assetRejected` — the asset itself is not acceptable, and offering less of it will not help. `amountRejected` — the asset is acceptable and the quantity is not.

message.description: The objection in the approver's own words.

reportId.description: The report the refused proposal belongs to.

proposalId.description: The proposal being refused. The event also references the proposal event itself, which is the protocol-level counterpart of this field.

details.description: Why the list was refused. At least one objection — a refusal that says nothing leaves the pledging side guessing.
